task_name: World 114 Task C  -  Counterparty Top-Down COGS % of MSRP vs. Retained Pre-Discount MSRP & Physical Unit Bridge (R51 / R58)

rubric.description: Reconciles raw YTD Sep 2026 Shopify units: 674,897 gross units ordered (620,850 physical garments + 54,047 virtual items) less 92,987 returned units (92,361 returned physical garments = 14.88% return rate) equals 581,910 net items sold (528,493 net physical garments + 53,417 virtual items: 16,666 Swap Protect, 33,900 Digital Style Guides, and 2,851/2,855 Gift Cards).

Proves that Baxter's 16.7% COGS rate equals $17.76/u delivered garment cost divided by ~$106.35 full retail MSRP, and that multiplying 16.7% by pre-return Gross Sales ($64,711,606.69 -> $10,806,838.32) overstates COGS by +$1,239,231.95 by charging COGS on 92,361 returned physical garments (-$7,420,550.60 returns).

Shows that applying 16.7% to Retained Pre-Discount MSRP ($57,291,056.09 = $64,711,606.69 Gross Sales - $7,420,550.60 Returns) yields $9,567,606.37, reconciling within $31,986.05 (0.3%) of bottom-up Total Landed COGS ($9,535,620.32 = $9,386,035.68 delivered garments + $149,584.64 packaging).

Explains why any COGS % benchmarked against full pre-discount MSRP ($17.76 / $106.35 = 16.7%) must be applied to Retained Pre-Discount MSRP (Gross Sales less Returns) rather than pre-return Gross Sales or post-discount Net Sales ($47,997,651.07).

prompt: Using `collars_inventory_unit_economics_and_counterparty_audit_2026_Q3.xlsx`, reconcile the raw YTD Sep 2026 Shopify gross, returned, virtual, and net physical garment units, and evaluate the counterparty's top-down 16.7% MSRP COGS benchmark against Gross Sales, Retained Pre-Discount MSRP, and bottom-up Total Landed COGS.
gold_output:
World 114 Task C  -  Counterparty Top-Down COGS % of MSRP vs. Retained Pre-Discount MSRP & Physical Unit Bridge (R51 / R58):
1. Raw Shopify Unit Bridge: YTD Sep 2026 raw Shopify exports show 674,897 gross units ordered (620,850 physical garments + 54,047 virtual items) less 92,987 returned units (92,361 returned physical garments = 14.88% return rate), leaving 581,910 net items sold (528,493 net physical garments + 53,417 virtual items: 16,666 Swap Protect, 33,900 Digital Style Guides, and 2,851/2,855 Gift Cards).
2. Counterparty 16.7% Gross Sales Error (+$1,239,231.95 Overstatement): Baxter's 16.7% COGS rate equals $17.76/u delivered garment cost divided by ~$106.35 full retail MSRP. Multiplying 16.7% by pre-return Gross Sales ($64,711,606.69 -> $10,806,838.32) overstates COGS by +$1,239,231.95 because it charges COGS on 92,361 returned physical garments (-$7,420,550.60 returns).
3. Retained Pre-Discount MSRP Reconciliation: Applying 16.7% to Retained Pre-Discount MSRP ($57,291,056.09 = $64,711,606.69 Gross Sales - $7,420,550.60 Returns, before -$9,293,405.02 promo discounts that reduce Net Sales to $47,997,651.07) yields $9,567,606.37, reconciling within $31,986.05 (0.3%) of bottom-up Total Landed COGS ($9,535,620.32 = $9,386,035.68 delivered garments + $149,584.64 packaging).
